label: Sitting silhouette — negative-space belly
revised_prompt: Minimalist two-tone vector logo of a capybara sitting in profile, designed like DeepSeek's whale: one continuous navy shape, white negative space carving the belly and snout. Side view, compact, almost filling a circle: rounded rump, short legs tucked in, blunt snout lifted slightly, tiny ear, tiny white eye. Calm, grounded, coworker energy — a peaceful work companion. Deep navy blue (#0A2342) and white only. Pure white background, centered, lots of padding. Flat vector app icon, no text, no 3D, no fur, no photorealism, no scenery, no sofa. Silhouette must remain readable at 32px. Ultra high resolution, crisp edges.
